title: Gorenje — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Gorenje.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "European Design." Specialty tier. Gorenje is a Slovenian appliance brand owned by Hisense Group. Known for designer collaborations and retro-styled appliances in Europe. Limited North American presence.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Gorenje:

• Slovenian design heritage

• Hisense Group backing

• Designer collaborations

• Retro styling options

• European engineering
